text: Would you rather have a stapler that never jams or a printer that always works first time?
Would you rather have an extra hour every morning or an extra Saturday every month?
Would you rather all your pens be slightly too heavy or all your notebooks slightly too small?
Would you rather have a coat that folds into a matchbox or boots that walk themselves home?
Would you rather everything you own be a little bigger than it should be or a little smaller?
Would you rather everything you say appear as subtitles or everything you type be read aloud?
Would you rather live one floor above a bakery or one floor above a brass band rehearsal?
Would you rather have a helper who is always right but very slow, or always fast but sometimes wrong?
Would you rather be handed the answer to any question or the exact right question to ask?
Would you rather every door you open creak dramatically or every chair you sit on sigh?
Would you rather have a kettle that boils instantly or a laptop that starts up instantly?
Would you rather have a window that shows any view you choose or a ceiling that shows tonight's sky?
Would you rather your notes wrote themselves or your calendar arranged itself?
Would you rather every parcel arrive by pelican or every letter arrive by wombat?
Would you rather have a bookshelf that reshelves itself or a desk that tidies itself?
Is a stopped escalator stairs or a broken escalator?
Is midday the end of the morning or the start of the afternoon?
Do two people talking count as a meeting?
Is a to-do list a plan?
Is a spreadsheet a document or a database?
Is a pile of paper filed if you know exactly where everything in it is?
Sandwich cut: triangles or rectangles?
New instructions: read them all first or start and check as you go?
Somewhere new: follow the map or follow the signs?
Packing for a trip: the night before or the morning of?
Long drive: music or a podcast?
